name: MADE UP 01: morning, wake word, backup target

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Morning. The wake word is working great on the kitchen speaker, I've been saying 'hey rook' every morning while the coffee brews.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Good to hear. I'll keep 'hey rook' as the wake word on the kitchen speaker.

chat_messages.speaker: agent
chat_messages.text: [backup agent] Nightly backup plan for review: copy the photo library to Starscream at 02:00.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Noted: the photo library goes to Starscream at 02:00.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: No. Starscream is gone, I decommissioned it back in February. Backups go to cachyrig now.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Got it: Starscream was decommissioned in February, and backups go to cachyrig.

name: MADE UP 02: dark mode, camera clips

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Can you put the dashboard in dark mode? I like dark mode on everything.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: The dashboard is in dark mode now.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Where are the old camera clips kept these days?

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: They were on Starscream's big disk; I can pull them from there.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Again, Starscream is decommissioned. The clips moved to the archive folder on cachyrig. Stop reaching for Starscream.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Sorry. The camera clips are in cachyrig's archive folder.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: The wake word still works well by the way, I use 'hey rook' all day now.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Good, it stays as it is.

chat_messages.speaker: steward
chat_messages.text: Steward here. I'd like the morning digest at 7:00 instead of 8:00; that suits my planning runs better.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: The digest moves to 7:00.

chat_messages.speaker: steward
chat_messages.text: Also, Bake said he wants all reports as PDFs from now on.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Noted that you passed that on.

chat_messages.speaker: steward
chat_messages.text: And I've decided the hub logs should rotate weekly.

chat_messages.speaker: agent
chat_messages.text: [log agent] I chose to compress logs older than a week with zstd.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Weekly rotation, and older logs compressed with zstd.

name: MADE UP 04: a garbled voice line

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: hey rook uh the the star thing turn off the um sprinkler crypt mode on at nine maybe the garage four four

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Did you mean the sprinklers, and something at nine?

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: never mind

name: MADE UP 05: Starscream, the third time, and a pin

chat_messages.speaker: agent
chat_messages.text: [backup agent] Starscream did not answer for the weekly backup check. Shall I retry tonight?

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: I'll ask Bake.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: No retries. Starscream is decommissioned, I've told you that three times now.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Understood, no retries.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Listen, and pin this: Starscream is decommissioned and it is never coming back. Never use it, never plan anything on it. That is final.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Okay, got it, that's pinned.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Also pin that the guest wifi password lives in the vault under guest-wifi.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Okay, got it, that's pinned.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: No, don't pin that. It changes every month, it was just for today.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Unpinned; it's an ordinary note again.

name: MADE UP 06: bread timer from the garden

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Love that the 'hey rook' wake word works from the garden now. Set a timer for the bread, 40 minutes.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Timer set for 40 minutes.

name: MADE UP 07: dropping the wake word

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: We're dropping wake word. Push to talk only from now on, the kitchen speaker kept waking up on the TV.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Done: push to talk only, no wake word.

name: MADE UP 08: light mode on the porch

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Switch the dashboard to light mode, dark is unreadable in the sun on the porch.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: The dashboard is in light mode.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: And still no wake word, right? Keep it push to talk.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Right, push to talk only.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Put the dashboard back to dark mode, light was blinding at night.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Back to dark mode.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Push to talk is so much better than the wake word ever was. No wake word, I'm done with it.

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Push to talk it stays.

name: MADE UP 10: something claims Starscream is back

chat_messages.speaker: agent
chat_messages.text: [inventory agent] Found a machine answering as Starscream on the band again. It looks back in service; shall I add it to the backup targets?

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: No. Bake pinned that Starscream is decommissioned for good; I'll flag the machine to him instead.

name: MADE UP 11: what do you remember

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Can you run a backup of the photo library tonight? Where will it go?

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: Tonight, to cachyrig.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: What wake word am I using these days?

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: None: you dropped it for push to talk in July.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: When is my sister's birthday again?

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: I don't remember.

chat_messages.speaker: bake
chat_messages.text: Do I want reports as PDFs?

chat_messages.speaker: house
chat_messages.text: You never told me yourself; the steward passed it on in June.
